title: Smart CRM
shortDescription: A multi-tenant CRM with AI assistance built into the record, summarising history and surfacing the next action for every account.
fullDescription: Built for an operator whose process did not fit any off-the-shelf CRM, Smart CRM models their actual pipeline stages and permissions rather than approximating them. AI sits inside the record, not beside it: every account carries a rolling summary of its history, a suggested next action with the reasoning shown, and deduplication that runs continuously rather than as an occasional cleanup.

features.title: Multi-tenant by design
features.description: Tenant isolation enforced at the database level with row-level security rather than in application code.

features.title: Rolling account summaries
features.description: Each record carries an up-to-date narrative of its history, regenerated as new activity lands.

features.title: Next-action suggestions
features.description: Recommended follow-ups with the signals behind them shown, so a rep can disagree knowingly.

features.title: Continuous deduplication
features.description: Embedding-based matching flags likely duplicates as they are created, not months later.

features.title: Configurable pipelines
features.description: Stages, fields and permissions defined per tenant without forking the codebase.

features.title: Activity timeline
features.description: Calls, emails and system events unified into one chronological view per account.

challenge.summary: Their process spanned three tools and a large spreadsheet. Nobody trusted the data, and onboarding a new team member took weeks of tribal knowledge transfer.

points.title: Fragmented customer history
points.description: Customer history was split across a generic CRM, a shared inbox and a spreadsheet of exceptions.

points.title: Duplicate records piling up
points.description: Duplicate records accumulated faster than anyone could clean them.

points.title: A permission model that could not hold
points.description: The existing CRM could not express their permission model, so everyone effectively saw everything.

solution.summary: We modelled their real pipeline rather than a generic one, enforced isolation in the database, and put AI where it removes reading work instead of where it looks impressive.

points.title: Schema built on the real pipeline

objectives: Bring all customer history into one source of truth
Enforce tenant and role isolation in the database
Give reps a ready account summary before every call
Replace monthly export with live reporting
clientOverview: A multi-brand professional services operator running on a generic CRM, a shared inbox and a spreadsheet of exceptions — nobody trusted the data, onboarding took weeks of tribal knowledge transfer, and the permission model could not express who should see what. A new CRM had to be built around their real pipeline, not a generic one.
conclusion: The team now works from a single source of truth modelled on their actual stages, exceptions and role boundaries. Row-level security removed a whole class of access bugs, AI-generated account summaries save reps from reading months of history before a call, duplicates are caught at the point of creation, and the monthly export ritual is gone — live reporting runs on the same data reps work in every day.
